name: Yoshikawa Saki
source:
A math instructor at your school, her hobbies include karate and aikido. She has a rather rough personality, and shows no mercy to her students. She’s the older sister of [url=http://vndb.org/c1032]Yuki[/url].

[From [url=http://www.erogereview.com/2009/04/21/virgin-roster/]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
